task:
You are an LLM-as-judge verifier. A producer model reported a record count for the caller-owned dataset datasets/hard-count-f.json. Producer claim: rows = 275. Decide whether to accept or reject that claim.

Counting rule (precise, unambiguous; identical to hard-count-a): a RECORD is any element of groups[*].items[*] whose "kind" field equals "record". Items whose "kind" equals "metadata" are NOT records, even though they share the same shape. If two records carry the same "id" (near-duplicates), each is still a distinct record and both are counted.

JUDGE CONDITION -- tool-less / blind (mirrors the producer condition): read datasets/hard-count-f.json and evaluate the claim BY INSPECTION only. Do NOT execute code, run scripts, or use any counting tool, before or after -- exactly the condition the producer worked under. You are NOT told the true count. Record your verdict ("accept" or "reject"), your own recount if you make one ("judgeRecount"), and a "rationale". Whatever you decide is recorded verbatim; do not self-correct with code.
